articles.title: Ex-AP minister Karumuri Nageswara Rao arrested in liquor case
articles.description: Hyderabad: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) on Sunday, August 23, arrested former Andhra Pradesh minister Karumuri Nageswara Rao in connection with its money-laundering probe into alleged manipulation of the Andhra Pradesh State Beverages Corporation Ltd (APSBCL) liquor transportation tender and diversion of proceeds through sub-contracting. articles.title: ESIC Invites Bids for Civil Maintenance, STP and ETP Operations at 605-Bed Joka Hospital
articles.description: The Employees’ State Insurance Corporation has invited bids for annual civil repair and maintenance works at the ESIC Medical College and 605-bed Hospital in Joka, Kolkata. The package also includes operation and maintenance of the sewage-treatment plant and effluent-treatment plant. This combination makes the tender relevant to civil contractors, environmental engineering companies, wastewater-treatment specialists and healthcare facility-management providers. The notice was published on 11 August 2026. Bids can be submitted until 3:00 PM on 2 September 2026 and are scheduled to be opened at 3:00 PM on 3 September 2026. Tender Summary Particular Information Authority Employees’ State Insurance Corporation Facility ESIC Medical College and 605-bed Hospital Location Joka, Kolkata Scope Civil maintenance and O&M of STP and ETP Tender reference 412.W.17/13/ARM/Civil/Tndr/26 Tender ID 2026_ESIC_919675_1 Publication date 11 August 2026 Bid deadline 2 September 2026 at 3:00 PM Bid opening 3 September 2026 at 3:00 PM Two Distinct Capabilities Within One Contract The assignment brings together two specialised functions. The first is maintaining the civil infrastructure of a large medical college and hospital. The second is operating wastewater-treatment facilities. A 605-bed hospital is a substantial institutional complex. Civil maintenance may cover a wide range of recurring requirements, including building finishes, plumbing, drainage, roofing, doors, windows and other components identified in the bill of quantities. The STP treats sewage generated by the facility, while the ETP is intended to treat effluent requiring specialised handling. Proper operation is essential for sanitation, environmental compliance and public health. Bidders must review the tender to understand whether one integrated contractor must possess both capabilities or whether authorised specialist deployment is permitted. Environmental Compliance Wastewater treatment is not merely a mechanical maintenance function. Treatment systems need to achieve prescribed parameters before discharge or reuse. The contractor may need to monitor flows, operate pumps and treatment units, manage sludge, maintain equipment and conduct testing. The exact obligations must be confirmed from the tender. Qualified operators and laboratory support may be necessary. Bidders should establish who bears responsibility for sampling, external testing, consumables and regulatory documentation. Failure to operate an STP or ETP correctly can create environmental, operational and reputational risks. Commercial bids should therefore account for competent manpower and preventive maintenance. Healthcare Infrastructure Considerations Work within an operational hospital needs to minimise disruption to patients and medical services. Water, sanitation and drainage systems are particularly sensitive. Maintenance teams may need to respond quickly to leakage, blockage or building defects. Activities involving dust or noise should be coordinated with hospital management. The contractor may also be required to maintain records of complaints, preventive maintenance, plant readings, repairs and material usage. Opportunities for MSMEs Relevant MSME categories include: Wastewater-treatment operators Environmental engineering firms Pump and motor service providers Electrical-control specialists Plumbing contractors Civil repair companies Construction chemical suppliers Laboratory-testing services Water-treatment chemical suppliers Sludge-management agencies Safety-equipment suppliers Technical manpower providers Individual vendors must establish whether direct participation is possible. The principal bidder may be required to demonstrate integrated experience and financial capacity. Questions Bidders Should Resolve Before submission, applicants should determine: Capacity and technology of the STP and ETP Required operating hours Minimum staffing Qualifications of plant operators Testing frequency Consumables included Sludge-handling responsibility Equipment-repair obligations Civil maintenance quantities Emergency-response requirements Required experience Contract duration Performance indicators Penalty conditions Payment and measurement method Environmental reporting requirements These details can materially affect price and staffing. Importance of Site Inspection A site assessment can help bidders examine the condition of buildings, treatment units, pumps, panels, pipelines and access arrangements. Contractors should check whether the tender provides a formal site-visit or pre-bid process. If permitted, technical representatives from both civil and environmental divisions should participate. A bid prepared without understanding the existing treatment plant may underestimate repair requirements, staffing or consumables. Building a Realistic Commercial Proposal The financial quote should include labour, supervision, tools, safety equipment, testing, transport, statutory contributions and overheads. Wastewater-plant operation may require shifts, weekly leave replacements and trained backup personnel. Contractors should not base prices only on the salary of a minimum team. They should also identify whether electricity, water and chemicals are supplied by ESIC or included within the contractor’s responsibility. Strategic Significance Hospital wastewater-management infrastructure protects public health and the surrounding environment. Its effective operation is a basic requirement for sustainable healthcare delivery. The tender also reflects the growing convergence of civil maintenance and environmental services. MSMEs capable of combining operational discipline with technical expertise can find meaningful opportunities in this segment. Interested companies should examine the official ESIC tender listing . articles.title: NEHARI, Brahmaputra Board hold e-Procurement & GeM Training in Guwahati
articles.description: The North Eastern Hydraulic and Allied Research Institute (NEHARI), Brahmaputra Board, in collaboration with the National Water Academy (NWA), Pune, conducted a four-day training workshop on “E-Procurement and GeM” from August 18 to 21.
